text.tspan: A final-year B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering student
at MVGR College of Engineering, Vizianagaram, graduating in 2027.
I like owning the whole stack. I wire the sensors, write the firmware in
Embedded C, train the vision model, and run a local LLM on top, with
no cloud needed. I built A.I.R, an offline companion rover on the
Arduino UNO Q, and KAISER, a personal AI agent that installs like a
normal Windows app, with 41 tools and 492 automated tests.
